title: Little Girl in White Dress on Front Porch, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming snapshot of a young toddler girl standing outside on the concrete front stoop of a brick home. She is holding onto a decorative black wrought iron railing, dressed neatly in a pleated white dress, white socks, and white shoes. Behind her, the screen door displays the house number 3081 above a decorative doormat. The print features classic mid-century deckled edges and top punch marks from an album or processing binder.
